parsedVerdict.reasoning: CancelBookingService is a use-case orchestrator, which is the job of the application layer. CancelBookingService.cancel loads the booking through the BookingRepository port and throws a not-found error if it is missing. It hands the cancellation rule to the domain entity (booking.cancel()). It then uses outbound ports to refund the payment (PaymentGateway), save the booking (BookingRepository), look up the guest (GuestRepository) and send a notification (NotificationSender). Finally it maps the booking to a view for the output port (toBookingView). The file contains no persistence code, transport/HTTP handling or framework logic. It also adds no business rules of its own: deciding whether a booking can be cancelled is left to the domain. Building a notification message string and sequencing side effects are normal application-layer tasks. No ADR prose was given.
